title: Rayah
desc: French-Moroccan café, pâtisserie, and restaurant with an entirely halal menu. Desserts include croissants, flan, pastries, and Moroccan/French sweets. Owned by Wafa El Rhazi. Hours are approximately Wednesday–Saturday 10:00 AM–10:00 PM and Sunday until approximately 9:30 PM; confirm directly before visiting.
ownedBy: Owned by Wafa El Rhazi; halal menu
